name: Dabeli
instructions: 1. Prepare the potato filling by sautéing the mashed potatoes with Dabeli masala and a splash of water, then garnish with pomegranate, sev, and peanuts.
2. Slice the ladi pav in half and toast them on a pan with a generous amount of butter.
3. Spread spicy garlic chutney on one side and sweet tamarind chutney on the other side of the bread.
4. Stuff a generous portion of the potato mixture into the pav.
5. Press the stuffed pav into fine sev so that it sticks to the sides of the potato filling.
6. Serve hot, garnished with extra peanuts, pomegranate seeds, and onions.
description: Originating from the Kutch region of Gujarat, Dabeli is a beloved street food icon. Often called the 'Kutchi Burger,' it represents a perfect balance of sweet, spicy, and tangy flavors with diverse textures provided by the crunchy sev, peanuts, and soft bread.
